faq.q: What is reflexology massage and why reflexological?
faq.a: The foot has zones that mirror organs of the body. Stimulating these zones with the right technique can ease distant tensions (headache, digestive fatigue, lower back pain). More than a foot massage — it is whole-body work.

hero.imgAlt: Professional massages at AnyLopez Aesthetic Clinic Benidorm
hero.lead: You have tried massages at spas that relaxed you for an hour but resolved nothing. Here every massage has an objective — real rest, decongestion, anti-fatigue, facial therapy — and is chosen after assessing what your body or face is asking for that day.

pain.eyebrow: Does any of this sound familiar?
pain.h2: Most patients who arrive here have been through the same thing.
pain.p: You are not coming from nowhere. You are coming after trying other things that did not quite work.

items.h3_html: You have tried massages that feel just like a day at the spa.
items.p: Pleasant scent, soft music, served exactly the same way as the previous person. Surface-level wellness, zero technique.

items.h3_html: You go in with cervical or lower-back tension and leave 'pleasantly relaxed' but just as tense.
items.p: A generic massage relaxes for an hour — a therapeutic massage truly releases.

items.h3_html: You want concrete benefits (drainage, decongestion, anti-fatigue, facial regeneration), not just aromatherapy.
items.p: A well-executed massage changes the state of the body.

why.h2: Six reasons why they work here where other places fall short.
why.p: It is not marketing. It is expert manual technique, judgement, and a specific approach for each case.

items.h3: Expert manual technique from decades of practice
items.p_html: Hands that diagnose while they treat. We do not hire trainees to cut costs.
Each has its own technique and objective: deep relaxing, therapeutic cervical, reflexology foot, anti-fatigue legs, facials with collagen or vitamin C.

items.h3: A prior assessment decides the modality
items.p_html: Not "what do you want" — but "what is your body asking for today". Sometimes deep relaxation; sometimes drainage; sometimes a regenerating facial.

items.h3: Combinable with body and facial treatments
items.p_html: Before an advanced facial, a cranio-cervical massage relaxes the muscles. Before drainage, a reflexology session mobilises energy. Real synergies.

items.h3: Sessions you feel from the very first one
items.p_html: You do not wait 10 sessions to notice something. The difference is palpable by the end of the first.

items.h3: Delivered by the person who signs off the result
items.p_html: The same standard as across the whole clinic: real experience, not an express certificate.

xsell.eyebrow: If you carry chronic muscle tension
xsell.p: For cases of persistent tension, lower-back pain, post-surgical recovery or structural cellulite, body treatments (specific muscle recovery, lymphatic drainage, wood therapy) go beyond massage.

process.p: From your first message to the moment you leave the first session, everything is clear.

steps.p: Call/WhatsApp to find a day and time. No commitment, no upfront payment.
